messages:
Jenna: Heads up — noticing an incident in eu-west causing p95 to jump ~500ms on inference nodes. I'm pausing today's microservice rollout. @Samir @Oliver @SRE-Oncall please ack and advise. :warning:
DeployBot: Deployment pipeline 'microservice-api' paused by jenna at 1723456789. Change window 'microservice-release-2026-03-20' is on hold. Auto-retry disabled.
Samir: Ack. Agree with hold. Can we pin the running image (v2.13.4-prod) and stop any auto retries? Suspect the KVCaching change interacts poorly with kernel eviction.
Oliver: On it — will run a quick staging perf/smoke and compare tail latencies. ETA ~12m. Any specific logs to check?
Jenna: No stack traces in app logs, looks like sustained tail latency across many tokens. Correlates with kernel eviction events in infra metrics. @SRE-Oncall could you confirm node-level evictions? If we don't clear, propose moving to next change window (Thu 09:00 PT).
SRE-Oncall: Confirmed: two GPU pods in eu-west-1a experienced kernel OOM/eviction around 20:14-20:17 UTC. We're isolating the host and collecting dmesg + nvidia logs. Recommend hold until we either patch kernel hotspot or rollback service change. Tentative unblock ETA 10:30 UTC.
Lena: If we reschedule, we need updated release notes + customer comms. I'll draft a short blurb for status page. Also request: set rollout flags so dedicated customers don't get the canary traffic.
Samir: Sounds good. Plan from infra perspective: pin v2.13.4-prod globally, disable canary for eu-west, and prepare 2.13.5-hotfix-a if rollback/patch needed. Which regions currently show the spike?
Jenna: Only eu-west shows the spike so far. Plan proposal: 1) pin current image everywhere to prevent partial rollouts 2) explicitly disable canary in eu-west 3) reschedule run to Thu 09:00 PT with rollback window 09:15–09:45 4) update release page + post an incident note in #incidents. Agree?
Oliver: :thumbsup: I'll post perf numbers in ~10m and hold any pending rollout jobs locally.
DeployBot: DeployBot: Deployment 'microservice-api' paused (reason: incident hold) by jenna at 1723456789. Auto-retry and canary rollout disabled for the paused job.
Samir: Please also add 'hotfix-blocker' to the PRs and remove automated fleet-swap triggers until cleared. I'll prepare the hotfix branch in case we need roll-forward.
Jenna: Doing the PR label now and updating the release checklist. Lena — ping me when the comms blurb is ready and I'll post. Thanks all, keep updates short in this thread.
Lena: Draft ready, posting to #incidents and will PM support for a short status banner.
SRE-Oncall: Uploading logs to the incident bundle now. Will share analysis when done.
Oliver: Perf checks done: staging tail improved after reverting KVCaching flag. Sharing numbers in next message.
Samir: Good — that points to the feature. If we can rollback that flag safely, we could keep the release window but prefer reschedule to be safe.
Jenna: Finalizing reschedule to Thu 09:00 PT and pinning images. Will reopen thread if unblock earlier. Thanks everyone.
